input.quote: 14.2 Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel.
input.rationale: The IP allocation matches our preferred position. Section 14.2 vests each Deliverable in Customer with an express present assignment from Vendor plus personnel assignments and further-assurance support. Section 14.1 confirms Customer owns all Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information and independently developed IP, with no transfer to Vendor beyond a limited processing right; the Customer Data definition (1.3) is broad and includes derived output, excluding only anonymized telemetry. Vendor retains only Vendor Technology (14.3), and any Vendor Technology embedded in a Deliverable is covered by the perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence in Section 13.2 (including modification and derivative works, transferable under 13.3). Section 14.2/14.4 create no joint ownership absent a separate signed instrument, and feedback use is limited with Customer retaining unrestricted rights in its own feedback. No assignment of Customer IP or data to Vendor appears anywhere in the document.
